rows.definition: AccountSessionCap computes one product/account row's session capacity (max concurrent sessions) from product policy plus env overrides, called by both fleetaccounts and dispatchtick.
rows.distinction: The CAPACITY-RESOLVING function - not SessionCap (the int field it fills) and not SessionSlot (an index into that capacity).

rows.definition: SessionCap is the int field (json session_cap) on an account/fleet status row carrying its resolved session capacity, filled by AccountSessionCap.
rows.distinction: The STORED capacity value - not AccountSessionCap (the function that computes it).

rows.definition: SessionSlot is the per-worker session-slot index field on dispatch-wave/account rows identifying which concurrent capacity slot a worker occupies.
rows.distinction: An INDEX into an account's capacity - not the base catalog's Slot (the scheduler free/busy signal event) and not SessionCap (the ceiling it indexes into).

rows.definition: FreeSlots is the int field on fleet capacity/status rows counting currently-unleased session slots for an account or the fleet total.
rows.distinction: The AVAILABLE count - not LeasedSlots (the occupied count) and not SessionCap (the ceiling both measure against).

rows.definition: LeasedSlots is the int field on fleet capacity/status rows counting currently-occupied session slots for an account or the fleet total.
rows.distinction: The OCCUPIED count - not FreeSlots (the unleased count).

rows.definition: applySessionControl applies one parsed SessionControlRequest verb (pause/resume/priority/pace) to a session.Table entry, returning the resulting session.State.
rows.distinction: The IN-PROCESS table mutation - not SessionControlRequest (the wire request it consumes) and not persistServeSessionRevision (the durable-persist step that follows it).

rows.definition: AssumeSessionTurns is the `--assume-session-turns` knob feeding headSessionPrior's presumed session length when no bounded Budget.TurnsLeft horizon is wired.
rows.distinction: The PRESUMED-length override - not DefaultAssumedSessionTurns (its compiled-in default) and not headSessionPrior (the resolver consuming it).

rows.definition: DefaultAssumedSessionTurns is the const (=50) default session-length assumption the head-anchored compaction burst gate uses when AssumeSessionTurns is unset.
rows.distinction: The COMPILED DEFAULT - not AssumeSessionTurns (the runtime override) and not headSessionPrior (the resolver).

rows.definition: gateway.Server.headSessionPrior resolves the {TotalTurns, CurrentTurn} horizon pair the head-anchored burst gate reads when no bounded budget horizon is wired.
rows.distinction: The RESOLVER method - not its two inputs, AssumeSessionTurns and DefaultAssumedSessionTurns.

rows.definition: BySession is the toolprocgate console-fault report field breaking fault counts down per session (json by_session).
rows.distinction: A PER-SESSION fault breakdown - not BySessionType (the cache-value report's per session_type breakdown) and not sessionsCodexLoop (a different, Codex-TUI loop-diagnosis lens).

rows.definition: BySessionType is the cache-value report field attributing session/shape counts back to their session_type front door (guard|serve|run), present on both the Bucket aggregate and ShapeCluster.
rows.distinction: Attributes by TYPE of session - not BySession (per individual session).

rows.definition: debugSessionVars is the gateway package's type alias (= guardvars.SessionVars) for the per-session drive-state row that /debug/vars mirrors for each live session.
rows.distinction: A TYPE ALIAS naming the /debug/vars shape - not SessionVars (the underlying guardvars type it aliases).

rows.definition: guardvars.SessionVars describes one session's live drive-state; the gateway package reuses it verbatim as its debugSessionVars alias.
rows.distinction: The underlying TYPE in internal/guardvars - not debugSessionVars (gateway's alias name for it).

rows.definition: defaultSessionRegistryPath resolves the default on-disk session-registry path when neither $FAK_SESSION_REGISTRY nor a --registry flag is given.
rows.distinction: The DEFAULT-PATH resolver - not FAK_SESSION_REGISTRY (the env var it falls back from).

rows.definition: DevSessionBenefit is the cache-value Track-3 report field (*DevSessionBenefitReport) holding the dev-session cache-benefit lens, deliberately never summed into FleetBenefit or Track 2.
rows.distinction: The REPORT FIELD - not DevSessionBenefitReport (the type it points to) or FoldDevSessionBenefit (the function that builds it).

rows.definition: DevSessionBenefitReport is the struct type folded by FoldDevSessionBenefit and rendered by RenderDevSessionBenefit, carrying Track-3 dev-session cache-benefit numbers.
rows.distinction: The TYPE - not the DevSessionBenefit field that points to it.

rows.definition: ExitSessions is the int field on fleet-benefit fold reports counting sessions that reached an exit (fold-completion) event.
rows.distinction: A COUNT of terminated sessions - not FreeSlots/LeasedSlots (live capacity counts, not exit counts).

rows.definition: FAK_SESSION_ID is the env var a relaunched/child fak process reads to learn the session id it serves under, set by guard child relaunch and recorded in the restart-chain journal.
rows.distinction: The env var carrying a session's identity across a relaunch - not the base catalog's SessionID (the in-process typed identifier) or FAK_SESSION_REGISTRY (the registry-path env var); also not fak_sessions, the Prometheus gauge of live sessions by run-state - this is one session's identity, that is a population count.

rows.definition: FAK_SESSION_REGISTRY names the C1 session-registry file path consulted by `fak session ls --durable/--fleet` and guard resume before falling back to defaultSessionRegistryPath.
rows.distinction: The REGISTRY-PATH override env var - not FAK_SESSION_ID (a single session's identity) or defaultSessionRegistryPath (the fallback resolver).

rows.definition: SessionFile is the sessionimage package const naming the fixed session.json file inside a session image's CAS layout.
rows.distinction: A FILENAME constant inside one session image - not the base catalog's sessionimage.Image (the whole archive) or SessionRow (a census join row).

rows.definition: maxSessionRespBytes bounds the byte size of one session's rendered HTTP/CLI response (accounts-rehome, session ls, signal).
rows.distinction: A BYTE-SIZE ceiling on one response - not maxCtxValueSessions (the context-ctx family's own count ceiling on tracked sessions, a different const in a different subsystem).

rows.definition: NewScheduler is the constructor name shared, independently, by internal/session (NewScheduler(policy) building a *Scheduler over StrictPriority/WeightedFair) and internal/microagent (NewScheduler(k) building a fixed-K local slot scheduler).
rows.distinction: The CONSTRUCTOR function - not the base catalog's Scheduler (the session-package type it returns).

rows.definition: parseHookSessionID extracts a session id from a Claude Code hook JSON payload, used by the precompact/stophook guard actuators.
rows.distinction: Parses the id OUT OF a hook payload - not FAK_SESSION_ID (the env var carrying identity across a relaunch).

rows.definition: persistServeSessionRevision persists a served session's current session.State to the durable session store as a new revision, called from the CLI session-control path.
rows.distinction: PERSISTS a revision to durable storage - not the ext catalog's PublishSessionRevision (the gateway change-feed publish) or applySessionControl (the in-memory mutation it follows).

rows.definition: runSessionEnvelope is the actuator behind `fak session envelope`, producing a resume/handoff envelope for a session.
rows.distinction: A CLI actuator producing an envelope - not the ext catalog's SessionResetDirective (the budget-exhaustion handoff payload) or cmdSession (the general session CLI dispatcher).

rows.definition: selfSession is the leaseref parameter naming the CURRENT process's own session id, threaded through ClassifyLiveness/ClassifyLive so a lease can be told apart from a peer's.
rows.distinction: THIS process's own session-id parameter - not the base catalog's SessionID (the general typed identifier).

rows.definition: gateway.SessionAccount describes one Claude subscription seat in the on-box roster shown by SessionEndpoints, marked with how it is currently used.
rows.distinction: One ACCOUNT/SEAT row - not SessionNode (one machine) or SessionEndpoints (the envelope both live in).

rows.definition: sessionActivity (built by newSessionActivity) is the gateway package's private tracker recording each live trace's in-flight/idle age, projected onto debugSessionVars.
rows.distinction: The LIVENESS TRACKER - not debugSessionVars (the /debug/vars row it feeds).

rows.definition: internal/sessionctl owns the redirect control op (out-of-band objective-change, #2755/#2756): payload, validation, and the per-session next-boundary mailbox plus live-objective store.
rows.distinction: The REDIRECT-op package - not applySessionControl (the session-runtime table mutator) or the base catalog's SessionControlRequest (the generic pause/resume/priority/pace wire request).

rows.definition: gateway.SessionEndpoints aggregates the roster `fak info`/guard-endpoints surfaces render: Accounts, Nodes, and an embedded Harness together.
rows.distinction: The AGGREGATE ENVELOPE - not SessionAccount/SessionNode (its member slices) or SessionHarness (its embedded field).

rows.definition: gateway.SessionFleet aggregates the cross-MACHINE SessionFleetMachine rows that the live `fak guard` provider exposes through `/debug/vars` for `fak info`.
rows.distinction: A live CROSS-MACHINE fleet snapshot - not SessionEndpoints (the single-machine roster) or SessionFleetMachine (one row within it).

rows.definition: gateway.SessionFleetMachine is one machine's row within the GATED-WIP SessionFleet aggregate, folded from a fleetpane.FleetDoc snapshot.
rows.distinction: ONE MACHINE row - not SessionFleet (the aggregate it belongs to).

rows.definition: gateway.SessionHarness is embedded in SessionEndpoints, describing the harness/runner surface (set via a SetSessionHarnessProvider hook) shown alongside accounts and nodes.
rows.distinction: The HARNESS surface - not SessionEndpoints (the envelope embedding it) or SessionNode (a machine row).

rows.definition: A not-yet-built append-only session-scoped ledger referenced only as a forward pointer (#2392) from atif/doc.go, session/scratch_lease.go, and worklog/worklog.go; those call sites deliberately stay silent on entry format pending that work.
rows.distinction: A PLANNED future ledger, not yet implemented - not ScratchJournal (the append-only ledger scratch_lease.go actually implements today).
gaps: SessionLedger is a #2392 forward pointer only; no concrete type exists yet

rows.definition: gateway.SessionNode describes one machine/node entry within SessionEndpoints' roster.
rows.distinction: ONE NODE row - not SessionAccount (a seat row) or SessionFleetMachine (the GATED-WIP cross-machine sibling).

rows.definition: sidecar.SessionRow is the census row type: one agent session joined across the four key data sources for `fak sidecar`.
rows.distinction: A CENSUS join row - not SessionFile (a filename constant inside a session image) or SessionAccount (a roster seat).

rows.definition: sessionsCodexLoop is the actuator behind `fak sessions codex-loop`, diagnosing repeated-goal-failure loops from a Codex TUI JSONL session's history.
rows.distinction: Diagnoses CODEX-TUI loop failures - not BySession (a per-session fault-count breakdown, a different lens).

rows.definition: internal/sessionsearch performs witnessed cross-session recall (a pure TF-IDF fold) over the guard tool-process journal, with cache-safe suffix-only injection and a usefulness witness (#2913).
rows.distinction: CROSS-SESSION RECALL over the guard journal - not sessionctl (the redirect control op) or SessionRow (a census join, not a recall index).

rows.definition: SessionStart is the Claude Code hook event name fak installs/actuates (guard_sessionstart.go) to inject a one-line MCP-verb discoverability hint into the first turn.
rows.distinction: A HOOK EVENT NAME/lifecycle point owned by Claude Code, only actuated by fak guard - not any in-process session type in this catalog.

rows.definition: gateway.Server.SetSessionEndpointsProvider wires a SessionEndpoints producer function into the server so /debug/vars and the endpoints route can render it.
rows.distinction: The PROVIDER-INJECTION setter - not SessionEndpoints (the value it wires).

rows.definition: The structural retirement relation behind a memory note's author-declared supersedes edge, resolved by ResolveSupersession so a withheld (superseded) note stops surfacing while its own supersedes edge still retires its target.
rows.distinction: A NOTE-RETIREMENT relation in memq/recall/selfquery - unrelated to Session (the drive record); the shared substring is coincidental English morphology (super + session), not a session-runtime concept.

rows.definition: tuiSessionsSchema is the const naming the TUI overview-sessions payload schema version (fak.tui.sessions.v1).
rows.distinction: A SCHEMA-VERSION STRING constant for the TUI sessions view - not SessionRow (the data it renders).

rows.definition: session.ScratchJournal is the append-only ledger interface a scratchpad lifecycle records onto TODAY - the real, currently-implemented mechanism SessionLedger (#2392) is a planned future generalization of.
rows.distinction: The CURRENT, implemented append-only ledger - not SessionLedger (the not-yet-built forward reference).
